Class MockEnvironment

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.core.env.AbstractEnvironment
org.springframework.mock.env.MockEnvironment
All Implemented Interfaces:
ConfigurableEnvironment, ConfigurablePropertyResolver, Environment, PropertyResolver
public class MockEnvironment extends AbstractEnvironment
简单的 `ConfigurableEnvironment` 实现，暴露了用于测试目的的 `setProperty(String, Object)` 和 `withProperty(String, Object)` 方法。
Since:
3.2
Author:
Chris Beams, Sam Brannen
